compound.headline: Runs backwards: net NH3 consumption at 0.002 /site/s, so the stated product pressure is high enough to drive the cycle in reverse.
lines: Product-inhibited: the surface sits at θ(NH3@fcc) = 0.880, so NH3 is not leaving it.
Not fully selective: side product N2 at 1.1e-05 /site/s also leaves the surface -- 90% of net gas production is NH3.
Rate control sits on NO*->NOH* (X_RC = +0.77).
Strongest thermodynamic brake: NO@fcc (X_TRC = -0.61) -- stabilising it further slows the cycle.
caveats: the network has 2 absorbing components, so these coverages and the TOF are the ODE at t = 1e+06 s from one starting coverage, not a unique steady state
p(NH3) was never stated, so the 1 bar reference is doing the work in its gas-exchange rates
1 step's aggregated ΔE disagrees with its endpoint energies by more than 0.05 eV
